titleStmt.title: The Chairman of the Revolutionary Committee to Minister O’Brien.

head.hi: The Chairman of the Revolutionary Committee to Minister O’Brien.

div.p: The undersigned, in the name of the revolutionary committee, presents his compliments to the dean of the diplomatic corps, his excellency Gen Edward C. O’Brien, and his distinguished colleagues, and acknowledges receipt of his note dated to-day, in which he suggests that the persons of the ex-President General Ferreira, his ministers, and the high State officials should be protected In reply I must state to your excellency that we are disposed to recognize in all its amplitude the right of asylum as soon as the diplomatic corps shall communicate to us the buildings in which the said persons have taken refuge under the protection of a diplomat.

The revolutionary committee at the same time informs the diplomatic corps that it intends to carry on with the greatest vigor the military operations in order to terminate as soon as possible this state of things.
The persons of Mr. Ferreira, ministers, and employees will receive every consideration provided they surrender or take shelter in the legations and cease from every kind of hostility.
